main.remarks: Denies policy evaluation when a protected operation is required but missing from the supplied policy context.

method.name: Evaluate
method.summary: Evaluate whether a protected operation is present in the supplied policy context.
method.returns: Deny when the protected operation is missing; otherwise allow.

method.name: EvaluateAsync
method.summary: Evaluate asynchronously whether a protected operation is present in the supplied policy context.
method.param: Cancellation token for the asynchronous stage evaluation.
method.returns: Deny when the protected operation is missing; otherwise allow.
